description: GNU cpio copies files to and from archives.

option.name: --absolute-filenames
tip: Do not strip file system prefix components from the file names.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-out modes.

option.name: --append
tip: Append to an existing archive.
Valid only in copy-out mode.

option.name: --block-size
tip: Set the I/O block size to BLOCK-SIZE * 512 bytes.

option.name: --create
tip: Create the archive (run in copy-out mode).

option.name: --dereference
tip: Dereference symbolic links (copy the files that they point to instead of copying the links).
Valid only in copy-out and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --device-independent
tip: Create device-independent (reproducible) archives.
Equivalent to --ignore-devno --ignore-dirnlink --renumber-inodes.
Valid only in copy-out mode.

option.name: --directory
tip: Change to directory DIR.

option.name: --dot
tip: Print a "." for each file processed.

option.name: --extract
tip: Extract files from an archive (run in copy-in mode).

option.name: --file
tip: Use this FILE-NAME instead of standard input or output.
Optional USER and HOST specify the user and host names for a remote archive.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-out modes.

option.name: --force-local
tip: Archive file is local, even if its name contains colons.

option.name: --format
tip: Use given archive FORMAT.
Possible values: bin, odc, newc, crc, tar, ustar, hpbin, hpodc.
All-caps spellings are also recognized.

next.name: bin
tip: The obsolete binary format.

next.name: crc
tip: The new SVR4 portable format with a checksum added.

next.name: hpbin
tip: The obsolete binary format used by HPUX cpio.

next.name: hpodc
tip: The portable format used by HPUX cpio.

next.name: newc
tip: The new SVR4 portable format, supporting file systems with more than 65536 inodes.

next.name: odc
tip: The old POSIX.1 portable format.

next.name: tar
tip: The old tar format.

next.name: ustar
tip: The POSIX.1 tar format; also recognizes GNU tar archives.

option.name: --help
tip: Give this help list.

option.name: --ignore-devno
tip: Don't store device numbers.
Valid only in copy-out mode.

option.name: --ignore-dirnlink
tip: Ignore the number of links of a directory; always assume 2.
Valid only in copy-out mode.

option.name: --io-size
tip: Set the I/O block size to the given NUMBER of bytes.

option.name: --link
tip: Link files instead of copying them, when possible.
Valid only in copy-pass mode.

option.name: --list
tip: Print a table of contents of the input.

option.name: --make-directories
tip: Create leading directories where needed.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --message
tip: Print STRING when the end of a volume of the backup media is reached.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-out modes.

option.name: --no-absolute-filenames
tip: Create all files relative to the current directory.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-out modes.

option.name: --no-preserve-owner
tip: Do not change the ownership of the files.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --nonmatching
tip: Only copy files that do not match any of the given patterns.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --null
tip: Filenames in the list are delimited by null characters instead of newlines.
Valid only in copy-out and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --numeric-uid-gid
tip: In the verbose table of contents listing, show numeric UID and GID.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --only-verify-crc
tip: When reading a CRC format archive, only verify the CRC's of each file in the archive, don't actually extract the files.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --owner
tip: Set the ownership of all files created to the specified USER and/or GROUP.
In copy-out mode, store the supplied owner information in the archive.
Prefix numeric UID/GID values with + to skip the user and group lookup.

option.name: --pass-through
tip: Run in copy-pass mode.

option.name: --pattern-file
tip: Read additional patterns specifying filenames to extract or list from FILE.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --preserve-modification-time
tip: Retain previous file modification times when creating files.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not print the number of blocks copied.

option.name: --rename
tip: Interactively rename files.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --renumber-inodes
tip: Renumber inodes.
Valid only in copy-out mode.

option.name: --reset-access-time
tip: Reset the access times of files after reading them.
Valid only in copy-out and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --rsh-command
tip: Use COMMAND instead of rsh.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-out modes.

option.name: --sparse
tip: Write files with large blocks of zeros as sparse files.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --swap
tip: Swap both halfwords of words and bytes of halfwords in the data.
Equivalent to -sS.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --swap-bytes
tip: Swap the bytes of each halfword in the files.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --swap-halfwords
tip: Swap the halfwords of each word (4 bytes) in the files.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --to-stdout
tip: Extract files to standard output.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: --unconditional
tip: Replace all files unconditionally.
Valid only in copy-in and copy-pass modes.

option.name: --usage
tip: Give a short usage message.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Verbosely list the files processed.

option.name: --version
tip: Print program version.

option.name: --warning
tip: Control warning display.
Multiple options accumulate.
Possible values: none, all, truncate, no-truncate.

next.name: all
tip: Enable all warnings.

next.name: no-truncate
tip: Disable warnings about field truncation.

next.name: none
tip: Disable all warnings.

next.name: truncate
tip: Enable warnings about field truncation.

option.name: -B
tip: Set the I/O block size to 5120 bytes.

option.name: -c
tip: Use the old portable (ASCII) archive format.

option.name: -I
tip: Archive filename to use instead of standard input.
Optional USER and HOST specify the user and host names for a remote archive.
Valid only in copy-in mode.

option.name: -O
tip: Archive filename to use instead of standard output.
Optional USER and HOST specify the user and host names for a remote archive.
Valid only in copy-out mode.
